# Launch Screen Assets

The launch image uses Esha's existing pink Korlix logo from
`apps/esha/assets/esha-korlix-pink.png`. Each scale entry preserves that original
1024-pixel image without altering its artwork.

`LaunchScreen.storyboard` centers the logo at 144 points with aspect-fit sizing
on Esha's cream background. These branded files replace Flutter's placeholder
launch assets.
